thread:
elaine: short sync  customers pushed: per-tenant cost + basic error analytics + small tracing hook before GA. we should scope a minimal, shipable surface.
mark: propose minimal slice: Tenant Dashboard (requests, p50/p95, error %), daily cost CSV export, and a single gateway span tagged with customer_id, model, route. no cross-service tracing.
jules: acceptance criteria sketch:
- Tenant Dashboard template in library; widgets load <1.5s
- CSV: daily per-tenant token count + cost estimate; accuracy within 7%
- Spans: emitted from gateway with tags (customer_id, model, route), sampling default 10%
- Error analytics: top-5 error messages by tenant with link to logs
sara: estimates: infra ~2 dev-weeks, frontend ~1 dev-week, ops runbook 1 day. billing lag ~2h -> note in UI.
mark: prioritization: sprint A = dashboard + CSV; sprint B = tracing hooks + runbook. reduces cross-team churn.
elaine: agreed. action: @mark infra ETA + PR plan, @jules mocks by Wed, @sara prepare FAQ for customers. ops-bot: RFC created https://redwood.internal/rfcs/observe-minimum-surface :bookmark_tabs:
